justice: Most visible space is allocated to multiple wide motor-vehicle lanes, while no sidewalk, crossing, or pedestrian zone is visible, indicating an uneven distribution of street space across road users.

Guardrails along the right edge and a raised median in the center organize vehicle movement well, but they also suggest that non-motorized users have little direct access or priority in the visible corridor.
